RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel hiring a female candidate is not evidence of discrimination. Public broadcasters currently prioritize digital transition, making her specialized digital media background a legitimate, non-discriminatory qualification despite your longer tenure. 

Alleging gender bias without concrete evidence—such as biased questioning or documented procedural breaches—will appear unprofessional and harm your standing at the broadcaster. Furthermore, a two-week delay for written feedback is standard in public sector HR processes.

Send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback to understand how the panel evaluated digital capabilities against traditional newsroom leadership. Only reconsider your position if their formal explanation reveals clear procedural irregularities or discriminatory criteria.
